name: SCCM: Tier Zero Hierarchy Control - Administrators
description: Optional and disabled by default to preserve findings for administrator access to protected targets. Selects only SCCM_AdminUser records with one of seven supported built-in device-control roles and All Systems on that exact role assignment in the same hierarchy. Does not classify mapped AD identities or group members, or inherit their Tier Zero labels. All Users and User Groups and the All security scope are not required. Application Author needs an editable deployed application; Security Administrator uses ordinary permission delegation. Custom roles are excluded.
